observations.rule: Practice Squad contract salaries enter Team Salary, subject to Article 33 section 6.
The 40-percent grievance attribution requires a filed player salary grievance and has resolution/year reconciliation rules.
Paragraph 5 salary attribution uses the year earned; deferred salary has separate valuation rules.
Elevation/continuation amounts do not constitute Paragraph 5 salary for Article 30 termination-pay purposes. That qualification is scoped to Article 30.

requiredImplementation: Separate admitted compensation from filed disputes and retained legacy claims.
Record source injury year, earning interval and payment/accounting year separately.
Reconcile postseason Benefits provisions before selecting salary/cap treatment; do not infer zero cap or grievance reserve solely from employment expiry.
limits: These provisions alone do not establish post-expiry interval classification or future-year rate changes.
No runtime payroll or accounting coefficient changed.
